notes: v1.14.529 — SIDE NAV EXIT IS HOLD-TO-FREEZE. #cs-nav-ext was labelled Exit and called showMode('command') — an Exit that silently went Home, which is what 'names say what the door opens' forbids. .528 matched the two surfaces in appearance; this matches them in behaviour. The onclick is removed and the item is wired through rd_holdGesture to rd_freeze, the same canonical helper on the same canonical function the dock uses, per Contract A2. It gains a hold hint so the gesture is discoverable, an .arming gold state so a plain tap gives feedback rather than reading as a dead control (Contract 14), and the red label the dock EXIT already carries as an owner exception. The hint hides with the other labels in the 1024-1099 collapsed rail.
